column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row <sub>/operations/<id> (ADR-0088 addendum (1) R7, addendum (2) S11). A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the operation's doors — 503 `unavailable`; the leader does not lead the operation, calls no steps; the reaper does not remove its rows, the cause goes to the log
